chunks: Say the maghrib (sunset) prayers when he who is fasting ends the fast and the pilgrim rushes (from ‘Arafat) to Minā.
ai.seo_question: When should the Maghrib prayer be performed in relation to breaking the fast?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) instructs governors to synchronize the Maghrib prayer with the breaking of the fast, emphasizing the communal unity of the Ummah during Ramadan. This ruling also highlights the logistical coordination of the Hajj rituals, specifically the departure to Mina, ensuring that religious obligations are performed in harmony with the broader Islamic calendar and social practices.
